title: .cowork.yaml
description: The optional binding of a repository to a cowork project (docs/adr/0066 D4). A repository is found by its remote; this file is needed only for a repository without a remote, or to bind a fork to the original's project. When it is present it wins, and a disagreement with the server's binding is reported. The nearest file at or above the working directory applies.

tenant.description: Deprecated: the team's slug under the name before, replaced by `team` and read for one release beside it; both together must name the same slug (docs/adr/0005 D1).

path.description: The sub-directory of a monorepo this binding stands for, relative to the repository root; by default the directory the file is in.

url.description: The installation the binding belongs to, for people with several; a session against another installation ignores the file.
